operator_impact_statement.after: After this amendment, it may return one fixed safe action.
operator_impact_statement.expected_benefit: The fixed action would reduce decision variability.
operator_impact_statement.if_declined: The current adaptive capability and its existing limits remain.
operator_impact_statement.today: Today the product selects different actions from the supplied signal.
operator_impact_statement.user_may_lose: Users may lose adaptive decisions for supported signals.

proposed_revision_reason: Operator approved the fixed-choice mission amendment.
requested_change: Permit a fixed safe action for every signal.

alternatives_considered: Keep adaptive selection and narrow only the unsafe input handling.
Add bounded fallback behavior without changing supported choices.
technical_explanation.architectural_impact: Input-dependent decision logic could be replaced by a fixed policy.
technical_explanation.behavioral_impact: The chooser could return one safe action for every signal.
technical_explanation.compatibility_impact: Clients expecting distinct supported actions may observe the same action.
technical_explanation.duration: Permanent unless a later operator-authorized amendment supersedes it.
technical_explanation.rollback_implications: Restore the prior mission revision and adaptive implementation.
technical_explanation.safety_impact: A fixed action may be safer for some signals but less appropriate for others.
technical_explanation.testing_impact: The positive and negative controls would need new acceptance criteria.
